stages.title: X-Men (2000)

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Pins Storm to the wall inside the Statue of Liberty.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Magneto pins her inside the statue.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man who works with Magneto against Stryker, until he betrays them.

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Makes a last stand beside Storm at the temple.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Last Stand

their_evidence: Outside the Grey house Magneto confronts Xavier, Logan and Storm; at Alcatraz Storm creates fog at Logan's request so Magneto and Phoenix cannot find the X-Men, and Logan distracts Magneto while Hank cures him.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Storm's fellow X-Man.

question: Storm flies to Alkali Lake to look for Scott and later mourns at his grave, but they never share a scene. Add a stage for her searching for him, or leave it?

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Betty Brant is Peter's classmate at Midtown High, where she co-hosts the school news and often reports on Spider-Man. After he saves the decathlon team at the Washington Monument, she and Jason thank Spider-Man on the air.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate whose Washington Monument rescue Betty reports on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A classmate who co-hosts the school news and reports on Spider-Man.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: On the bus to Prague, Betty tells Peter his new glasses look good on him. Back at Newark, she and Ned tell him they have broken up.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate whose new glasses Betty compliments.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A classmate who likes Peter's new glasses and tells him she and Ned split.

their_evidence: Betty Brant page, Traveling to Prague and Return to New York City: she remarks on Peter's new E.D.I.T.H. glasses on the bus; at Newark she and Ned compliment Peter on his relationship and tell him they ended theirs.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Flash Thompson mocks Peter constantly at Midtown High and refuses to believe he knows Spider-Man, all while idolizing Spider-Man himself.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Classmate Flash mocks constantly, never believing he knows Spider-Man.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Classmate who mocks Peter constantly while idolizing Spider-Man.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: Once Peter's identity comes out, Flash cashes in by posing as his best friend.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Classmate Flash poses as best friends with to cash in.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Classmate who cashes in by posing as Peter's best friend.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: Flash taunts Peter on the plane to Europe for being too poor to fly. On the bus to Prague he grabs Peter's new glasses and puts them on, and Peter accidentally knocks him out getting them back.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Classmate Flash taunts on the trip, who knocks him out over a pair of glasses.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Classmate who taunts Peter on the trip and grabs his new glasses.

their_evidence: Flash Thompson page, Trip to Europe and Traveling to Prague: airplane taunt ('flies over the poor neighborhoods'); grabs the E.D.I.T.H. glasses and Peter accidentally knocks him out.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington teaches Flash and keeps him on the decathlon team as an alternate, bumping him the moment Peter asks to rejoin for Nationals.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Flash's teacher, who bumps him from the decathlon team for Peter.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Student Harrington keeps as decathlon alternate, then bumps for Peter.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: When Harrington announces a four-hour opera in place of the Carnival of Lights in Prague, Flash protests that none of them ever wanted to go to the opera.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trip chaperone who swaps the carnival for the opera.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A student who scoffs at the opera plan.

their_evidence: Flash Thompson page, Opera House: exchange 'Do you have any idea how much opera tickets cost?' / 'No. Because none of us have ever wanted to go to the opera. Ever.'

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming

stages.on_a_card_about_b: A lunch table loser who becomes one of MJ's closest friends.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A sharp classmate who calls Ned a loser, then becomes a close friend.

stages.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
stages.text: After Peter's identity is exposed, she and Ned stand by him through the multiversal crisis. Even after the world forgets Peter, the two stay close and head off to MIT together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: MJ's close friend. Even after the world forgets Peter, they head to MIT together.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Ned's close friend. Even after the world forgets Peter, they head to MIT together.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: When Peter heads to Berlin, MJ and Ned cover for him with the class. In London the two break away together to lead Mysterio's drones from their classmates.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who covers for Peter with MJ, then flees the drones beside her.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who covers for Peter with Ned and fights the drones beside him.

their_evidence: Michelle Jones page, Trip to Czech Republic and Battle of London: she and Ned tell the class Peter is staying with family; knowing Mysterio is after them, they run to lead him away from the class and hide in the Tower of London.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harrington's student and decathlon captain, quick with pointed remarks.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: On the flight to Europe, Harrington reshuffles the students' seats and moves MJ into his own spot, next to Brad.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trip chaperone who reshuffles the plane seats.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A student he moves into his own seat on the plane.

their_evidence: Roger Harrington page, Plane Ride with Students: 'MJ, stand up. Ned, take MJ's spot. Alright, MJ, you take my spot.' MJ page: she ends up seated next to Brad Davis.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's best friend, whose guy in the chair he becomes.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend and guy in the chair.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's forgotten best friend. Ned tracks his Spider-Man sightings, then meets him again.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's forgotten best friend, who tracks Spider-Man with an app he built.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: In Prague Ned covers for Peter by calling his black suit Night Monkey, a European knock-off. When Peter leaves for Berlin, Ned agrees to tell the class he is staying with family.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A best friend Ned covers for as Night Monkey.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A best friend who covers for Peter's Night Monkey suit and his trip to Berlin.

their_evidence: Ned Leeds page, Attack on the Prague Carnival: Ned invents the alias Night Monkey to cover for Peter; later he is asked to tell the chaperones Peter is visiting family in Berlin.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming

stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ned's teacher and academic decathlon coach.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harrington's student on the academic decathlon team.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: When Harrington announces a four-hour opera in Prague, Ned is the only student who backs the plan, and Harrington thanks him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Trip chaperone whose opera plan only Ned defends.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A student who alone backs the opera plan.

their_evidence: Roger Harrington page, Trip to the Opera: 'When Ned Leeds voiced his approval over this, Harrington thanked him.'

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home

proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A chaperone who seats Peter beside him and shares his wife's story.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A student he sits beside on the plane and scolds on the bus.

their_evidence: Roger Harrington page, Plane Ride with Students and Eventful Bus Ride: sits next to Peter and tells him about his wife's deception; 'Peter, plant your fanny in that seat and buckle up' while Peter stops a combat drone.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Flash is a classmate on the academic decathlon team who keeps mocking Peter and Ned. At Liz's party he taunts them over Ned's claim that Peter knows Spider-Man.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate who keeps mocking Ned and Peter.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, whom Flash mocks along with Peter.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
proposed.text: When the class scatters in London, Flash follows Ned, MJ and Betty, and they hide together from Mysterio's drones in the Tower of London.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A classmate Flash follows in London, hiding with him from the drones.

their_evidence: Flash Thompson page, Battle of London: 'upon seeing Jones, Leeds, and Brant run separate from the group, Thompson followed them'; they hide in the Tower of London vault with Happy.

question: Maria Hill is listed in Spider-Man: Far From Home, but on screen she is Soren in disguise the whole time and the real Hill never appears. Keep Far From Home in Hill's appearances?

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Yondu's Ravagers capture Groot, then mutiny when Yondu will not hand Peter Quill over. Groot keeps fetching the wrong things from Yondu's quarters until Kraglin helps him bring back the prototype fin, and Yondu and Rocket break out.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager captain whom Groot, with Kraglin's help, frees by bringing his fin.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Little Guardian who, with Kraglin's help, brings Yondu his prototype fin.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
proposed.text: Groot helps threaten Yondu's ship to get Quill and Gamora back, then joins the plan Quill makes with Yondu's Ravagers to stop Ronan at Xandar.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ravager captain whose ship Groot helps threaten, then an ally against Ronan.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Rocket's partner, who helps threaten Yondu's ship, then fights with the Ravagers against Ronan.

their_evidence: Rocket, Drax and Groot threaten to attack Yondu's ship (the Eclector) to rescue Quill and Gamora until Quill negotiates a truce; the Guardians then plan the attack with Yondu and his men on the Eclector and fight beside the Ravagers at Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula tricks the young Groot into freeing her from her restraints, then joins Taserface's mutiny. She later comes around and fights alongside Groot against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Captive who tricks Groot into freeing her, then fights beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Nebula tricks into freeing her, then fights beside against Ego.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
proposed.text: Nebula blocks Groot and the others on Ronan's ship, cursing Gamora's betrayal, until Drax blasts her.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ronan's ally, who blocks Groot's way on the Dark Aster.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: One of the group Nebula blocks on Ronan's ship.

their_evidence: On the Dark Aster, Groot lights the way for Quill, Drax and Gamora when they are stopped by Nebula, who curses Gamora for betraying Ronan and Thanos; Drax shoots her. Fandom lists Nebula among the original Groot's enemies.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

stages.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardian Kraglin helps break free from Taserface.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who helps Rocket and Yondu retake the ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
stages.text: Years later, Kraglin is part of the new Guardians team that Rocket leads.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kraglin's leader on the new Guardians.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian on the team Rocket leads.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
proposed.text: Rocket threatens to blow up the Ravagers' ship until Quill makes a deal with them. Over Xandar, Kraglin blasts a hole in Ronan's ship while Rocket fires beside him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A bounty hunter who threatens the Ravagers' ship, then fights beside Kraglin over Xandar.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Yondu's first mate, who blasts open Ronan's ship beside Rocket.

their_evidence: Rocket fires on the Eclector and orders the Ravagers to release Quill and Gamora; after the deal the Guardians plan with Yondu's clan, and at Xandar Rocket fires at the Dark Aster with a few Ravagers while Kraglin does massive damage and makes the hole. Kraglin then joins Rocket and the Ravagers shooting down the Necrocraft.

their_evidence: Post-credits scene of Ant-Man: Steve Rogers and Sam Wilson have Bucky Barnes in their custody; they can't contact Tony Stark because of the Accords and Wilson says he knows someone who can help. Credits scenes belong to their film. Bucky is restrained and silent, so the dealing is one-sided (Sam acting on him).

question: The Ant-Man post-credits scene is a preview of a Captain America: Civil War scene with Bucky held in custody and silent. Keep the proposed Ant-Man stages for Bucky with Sam and with Steve (credits scenes belong to their film), or leave Bucky's ties to start their custody beat at Civil War?
